$comment: Scheme data files under schemes/, one entry per scheme. Each loads from its file with `shelfmark scheme compile <file>`; none is compiled into the binary. A `distribution: fetch` entry is built locally from its source and never committed.

schemes.name: acm-ccs
schemes.title: ACM Computing Classification System
schemes.license: ACM, Inc.: educational and research use; not redistributable, so not bundled

schemes.name: eurovoc
schemes.title: EuroVoc (multilingual thesaurus of the EU Publications Office)
schemes.license: EU reuse terms stated inconsistently (Commission reuse notice in dataset metadata, CC0 in a third-party registry); not bundled, built from the Publications Office download

schemes.name: ipc
schemes.title: International Patent Classification (IPC)
schemes.attribution: International Patent Classification (IPC), World Intellectual Property Organization (WIPO), edition 20260101. Licensed CC BY 4.0. Reformatted by shelfmark; not endorsed by WIPO.

schemes.name: lcc-full
schemes.title: Library of Congress Classification: complete schedules
schemes.license: US government work, no US copyright (17 U.S.C. 105)
schemes.attribution: Library of Congress Classification, Library of Congress, Policy, Training, and Cooperative Programs Division.

schemes.name: openalex-topics
schemes.title: OpenAlex Topics (domain > field > subfield > topic)
schemes.attribution: OpenAlex topics data, CC0 1.0 public domain dedication. Reformatted by shelfmark.

schemes.name: fdc
schemes.title: Free Decimal Correspondence
schemes.attribution: Free Decimal Correspondence v0.06, edited by John Mark Ockerbloom; dedicated to the public domain (CC0 1.0). Reformatted by shelfmark.

schemes.name: ilc2
schemes.title: Integrative Levels Classification, edition 2 (ILC2)
schemes.license: Unsettled: the publisher's SKOS file says CC BY 3.0, BARTOC lists CC BY-SA 3.0, no iskoi.org page states a license; not bundled

schemes.name: unesco-thesaurus
schemes.title: UNESCO Thesaurus
schemes.attribution: UNESCO Thesaurus, © UNESCO. Licensed CC BY-SA 3.0 IGO. Adapted by shelfmark (English labels; one primary parent per concept, other broader links retained as vocabulary); not endorsed by UNESCO.

schemes.name: bk
schemes.title: Basic Classification (Basisklassifikation, BK)
schemes.attribution: Basisklassifikation (BK), Verbundzentrale des GBV (VZG) for the Gemeinsamer Bibliotheksverbund (GBV), CC0 1.0. Attribution is not required; credit is given as courtesy. Reformatted by shelfmark.

schemes.name: learned
schemes.title: Learned general classification (similarity- and navigation-optimized prototype)
schemes.attribution: Generated by shelfmark's schemes/learned builder from the benchmark corpus and similarity graph; dedicated to the public domain (CC0 1.0). Attribution is not required.
